evidence.notes: The local runtime accepts AccessLevel and returns the same no-delivery SaveResult as EventBus.publish.
The callback overload reuses local EventBus.publish callback handling and ignores AccessLevel.
The list callback overload returns ordered local SaveResult values and ignores AccessLevel.

source.content: Database.SaveResult one = EventBus.publishWithAccessLevel(new Account(Name = 'User'), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> two = EventBus.publishWithAccessLevel(new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'System')}, null, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, two.size()); System.assert(two[0].isSuccess());

args: Database.SaveResult one = EventBus.publishWithAccessLevel(new Account(Name = 'User'), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> two = EventBus.publishWithAccessLevel(new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'System')}, null, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, two.size()); System.assert(two[0].isSuccess());
